To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the newly synthetized methoxycarbolyprazolyl derivatives are potent Δ(5)-5β-HSD inhibitors, and they exert moderate inhibitory action on C17,20 lyase, 17β-HSD type 3, and antiproliferating effects against Hela, A431 and MCF7 cells.

5a, 5d and 6a are promising inhibitors of Δ(5) -3β-HSD, 5d is a potent inhibitor of the growth of HCT116, A431 and MCF7 cells and that 5e, 5d, 9d and 6d inhibit the growth of Hct116 and MCF7 cancer cells.
methoxycarbolyprazolyl compounds with an unsaturated D-ring exert a stronger inhibition of Δ(5)3β-HSD than the corresponding D-ring-saturated compounds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and biological evaluation of methoxycarbonpyrazolyl androstene derivatives, with special emphasis on their antiandrogenic and antiproliferation potential.
the synthesis of new methoxalylpyrazolyl derivatives of 5β-pregnane and androst-5-enes, and with the determination of their in vivo antiandrogenic activity.
the synthesis of new methoxylcarbonylpyrazole derivatives and their potential inhibitions of the activities of steroidogenic enzymes.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the methoxycarbolyprazolyl androstene derivatives investigated in the present work are not promising inhibitors of androgen biosynthesis, but some of them exhibit antiproliferation activity in vitro.

methoxycarbonlypyrazolyl derivatives are not promising inhibitors of androgen biosynthesis, whereas the 3β-hydorxy-21-methyl-4-tolylpyrazolyl compound 5d is the most potent antiproliferator of the cell lines investigated.
methoxycarbolylation in the C-21 side chain and pyrazolyl substituent at C-3 of the androstene nucleus are favorable structural elements for antiandrogenic and antiproliferating activities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the methoxycarbolylation of the C21 position of the steroid skeleton has a significant influence on the inhibitory effect of the pyrazole derivatives against Δ(5)-β-HSD and 17β-HSD type 3, while the presence of the 3-β-hydroxy group is essential in the inhibition of Δ(5)3β-HSD activity.

the 3β-hy-droxy-21-methylcarboxylated Δ(5)-androstene derivatives bearing a 4-toluyl or 4-hydroxyphenyl substituent on the pyrazole ring are the most potent inhibitors of Δ(5)3β-HSD, while the 3β-keto counterparts are the most effective inhibitors of androgen biosynthesis.

3-keto compounds are more potent than 3β-hydrxy compounds in inhibiting Δ(5)-HSD, while Δ(5)-hydroxy compounds are more effective than 3-keto analogs in inhibiting the proliferation of tumor cell lines.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the 3β-homoallylic alcohol moiety of the methoxycarbolylylpyrazol-5-one ring system is essential for the inhibition of the Δ(5)-reductase, while the 3-β-hydroxy group is required for the antiproliferation of the tested cancer cell lines.
the 3β-hydoxy-21-metoxalylpregnen-20-ones (5) and 3-keto-21-methoxyalypregn-5-ene-20-ones are potent Δ(5)-HSD inhibitors, and the 3-ketone analogs are potent inhibitors of 17β-HSD type 3.
the methoxycarbolyprazolyl compounds are potent inhibitors of Δ(5) -3β-HSD and 17β-HSD.
